summary: Mobilicom Ltd filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated October 12, 2026, announcing the launch of SwarmiX, a family of secure mesh communications solutions for drone swarms and networked autonomous fleets, debuting at AUSA 2026. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or regulatory clock is disclosed; the filing only incorporates the first paragraph by reference into existing Form S-8 and Form F-3 registration statements. This is a routine product-launch disclosure by a foreign private issuer, not a special situation; no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
